invariant: Every Invoke ontology claim and line selector must remain bound to the current public source bytes without changing stable ontology identity or implying acceptance, promotion, or publication.
root_cause: The three canonical Invoke source files gained mandatory identity, execution-designation, readiness-proof, and preacceptance-closure rules after the ontology package recorded their prior file digests and line selectors; the Invoke root then added mandatory validation of the emitted owner request through the ordinary presentation path.
